name: Hospitality equipment renewal (RD 638/2026)
amount_text: €5,000 to €11,000 per establishment, up to 100% of cost (excl. IVA)
next_call: A one-off emergency plan. No further call announced.
paid: Paid in order of complete applications until the €15M budget runs out, so incomplete applications lose their place. After approval you have 1 month to install and 15 days to justify. Costs from 1 March 2026 can count.
summary: Replace old catering equipment, AC units, awnings or terrace umbrellas with more efficient models. It pays up to 100%, so it can cost you nothing.
covers: Catering equipment: induction hobs, electric ovens and fryers, dishwashers, glass washers, blast chillers
Refrigeration: cold rooms, freezers, fridges, refrigerated counters and display cabinets, ice makers
AC units, awnings and terrace umbrellas
Installation, removal of the old equipment and the energy certificate
Managing the application (up to 4%) and the justification (up to 7%)
obligations: Replace existing equipment, not add new equipment.
No gas or other fossil-fuel equipment.
Install within 1 month of approval and justify within 15 days.
Don’t claim the same costs from another grant.
docs: Digital certificate of the legal representative, plus AutoFirma
Invoice or detailed quote for the new equipment
Energy efficiency certificate from a qualified technician
steps: List the equipment to replace and get quotes for more efficient models.
Prepare the project description and proof of the energy saving.
Apply on the Ministry’s Portal de Ayudas before 30 Sep 2026 at 15:00.
Once approved, install within 1 month.
Justify within 15 days with invoices, proof of payment, energy labels and the waste certificate.
verification_note: Checked against BOE and the Ministry’s applicant guide.

name: Cuota Cero (Línea 1)
amount_text: About €1,000: a full refund of 12 months of tarifa plana
next_call: This call ends 30 Sep 2026. Watch for the next one.
paid: Refund paid to your bank account after approval.
summary: The Junta refunds the €80-a-month tarifa plana you paid in your first year, so your first 12 months of Social Security cost nothing.
covers: Your autónomo Social Security quota for 12 months (24 if your income stays under the minimum wage)
obligations: Stay registered as autónomo for 12 months.
steps: Finish your 12 months on the tarifa plana.
Open “Subvenciones Línea 1. Cuota cero” on the Junta de Andalucía e-office.
Enter your details and bank account and sign. No attachments: the Junta checks your records itself.
Receive the refund once approved.

name: Start-up grant for new autónomos (Línea 2)
amount_text: €3,800 or €5,000 depending on age and gender (up to €5,500 in towns under 10,000)
next_call: This call ends 30 Sep 2026. Watch for the next one.
paid: One-off lump sum, handled in order until the budget runs out.
summary: A one-off payment to help you start out as a new autónomo in Andalucía.
covers: General start-up support: you justify it by staying registered, not with receipts
obligations: Stay registered as autónomo for 12 months in a row.
Don’t work as an employee for more than 25% of that period.
Stay up to date with Hacienda, Social Security and the Junta.
Keep the paperwork for 5 years.
docs: Viability plan with a provisional profit-and-loss forecast (profit every year)
Proof of RETA registration (resolución de alta)
steps: Register as autónomo and request the tarifa plana.
Prepare the viability plan.
Apply within 2 months of registering, and before 30 Sep 2026.
Receive a one-off payment if approved.

name: Kit Digital (digital voucher)
body: Red.es, Ministerio para la Transformación Digital
next_call: Runs until the funds are used up.
paid: A voucher spent with an approved digital provider (agente digitalizador), not cash.
summary: A voucher to pay an approved provider for digital tools. You never receive cash.
obligations: Use an approved agente digitalizador.
Keep the solution running for 12 months.
docs: Proof of being up to date with Hacienda and Social Security
steps: Complete the digital self-assessment on Acelera Pyme.
Apply on the Red.es e-office.
If approved, choose an approved provider and sign the agreement.
The provider delivers (website, e-commerce, social media, POS, cybersecurity) and both sides justify.
verification_note: Extended by Orden TDF/39/2026 until funds run out. Sources disagree on whether applications are open right now and on exact amounts: confirm on Acelera Pyme before applying.
hidden_reason: No open call: BOE Orden TDF/39/2026 only extends the programme. Amounts differ between sources. Re-publish when Red.es opens a call.

name: Hiring grant: Talento Joven
paid: Paid after you justify the contract. Only 10 grants for 2026, first come first served.
summary: €5,000 when you hire a young person from the Cámara’s Garantía Juvenil programme full-time for at least 6 months.
covers: Salary costs of the new hire
obligations: Keep the contract full-time for at least 6 months.
docs: Application forms (anexos) from the Cámara de Málaga e-office
Full-time contract of 6 months or more
Proof the hire is in Garantía Juvenil and finished Talento Joven orientation
Certificates of being up to date with Hacienda and Social Security
steps: Confirm the candidate is on the Cámara’s Talento Joven programme.
Sign a full-time contract of at least 6 months.
Apply on the Cámara de Málaga e-office (procedure TR0000006728).
Submit the justification forms to get paid.

name: Hiring grant: Talento 45+
paid: Paid after you justify the contract. Only 10 grants for 2026, first come first served.
summary: €5,000 when you hire an unemployed person aged 45 to 60 from the Cámara’s Talento 45+ programme full-time for at least 6 months.
covers: Salary costs of the new hire
obligations: Keep the contract full-time for at least 6 months.
docs: Application forms (anexos) from the Cámara de Málaga e-office
Full-time contract of 6 months or more
Proof the hire is a Talento 45+ participant
Certificates of being up to date with Hacienda and Social Security
steps: Confirm the candidate is on the Cámara’s Talento 45+ programme.
Sign a full-time contract of at least 6 months.
Apply on the Cámara de Málaga e-office (procedure TR0000006723).
Submit the justification forms to get paid.

name: INEA energy incentives for businesses (Programa 2)
amount_text: Roughly 55% to 65% of eligible cost; projects from about €11,000
paid: Paid after the installation is justified.
summary: The Junta pays part of energy projects. An approved installer usually handles the application for you.
covers: Solar panels and batteries for your own use
obligations: Energy certificates before and after the works, validated independently.
docs: Quote from an approved collaborating company
Energy efficiency certificate before the works
steps: Get a quote from a collaborating installer (they usually apply for you).
Apply before starting any works.
Install and get the after-works energy certificate.
Justify and receive the incentive.
verification_note: Programme confirmed open. Percentages and minimum project size come from installer sources, not the official text.
hidden_reason: Intensity (55–65%) and minimum project size came from installers, and fund availability per line can’t be confirmed on the Agency site. Verify against the official call.

name: PYMETUR: modernising tourism and hospitality businesses
amount_text: Set in the final rules (not yet published)
next_call: Not open. Only draft rules exist (public consultation, June 2026). The final rules and the call haven’t been published in BOJA yet.
paid: First come, first served (non-competitive) according to the draft rules.
summary: A planned grant for tourism and hospitality SMEs in Andalucía. It will open once the Junta publishes the final rules in BOJA.
covers: Modernisation, accessibility and sustainability of tourism businesses (per the draft; final scope set by the approved rules)
obligations: Projects must not start before applying.
docs: Registration in the Registro de Turismo de Andalucía
Certificates of being up to date with Hacienda and Social Security
steps: Make sure the business is in the Registro de Turismo de Andalucía.
Plan the project (modernisation, accessibility, sustainability, climate adaptation or quality certification) and get quotes.
Apply when the call opens, before starting works.
official_ref: BOJA nº 109, 9 Jun 2026: draft rules submitted to public consultation
verification_note: Checked against BOJA. Details will change when the final rules are published.

name: Pyme Innova (innovation projects)
next_call: Expect the next call around March 2027.
paid: You pay the supplier in full, then get 85% back.
summary: A Cámara tutor helps you plan an innovation project, then you get 85% of the cost back.
covers: Innovation in products, services or processes
obligations: Finish the project within 6 months.
steps: Apply in the call window on the Cámara e-office.
Free innovation diagnosis by a Cámara tutor.
Choose a supplier, pay 100%, receive 85% back.
verification_note: Málaga includes hospitality (IAE group 67). Turnover and IAE-date rules taken from the same programme in other Cámaras.
hidden_reason: Eligibility rules were taken from other Cámaras. Verify the Cámara de Málaga’s own 2026 call.

name: Pyme Digital (website, e-commerce, digital marketing)
next_call: The 2026 call ran 9 to 13 March. Expect the next around March 2027.
paid: You pay the supplier in full, then get 85% back.
summary: A Cámara tutor diagnoses your digital needs, then you get 85% of the project cost back.
obligations: Finish the project within 6 months.
steps: Apply in the March window on the Cámara e-office.
Applications are ordered by a notarised draw.
Free digital diagnosis.
Choose a supplier, pay 100%, receive 85% back.

name: Pyme Sostenible (energy efficiency, carbon footprint)
next_call: The 2026 call ran 6 to 12 March. Expect the next around March 2027.
paid: You pay the supplier in full, then get 85% back.
summary: A Cámara tutor diagnoses your energy use, then you get 85% of the improvement project back.
obligations: Finish the project within 6 months.
steps: Apply in the March window on the Cámara e-office.
Applications are ordered by a notarised draw.
Free sustainability diagnosis.
Choose a supplier, pay 100%, receive 85% back.

name: Innovactiva: young entrepreneurs
next_call: The 2026 call ran 5 March to 5 April. Expect the next around March 2027.
paid: Competitive. Covers investment only (equipment, fit-out, software), not running costs.
summary: For entrepreneurs aged 18 to 35 starting a business in Andalucía. Projects are scored against each other.
obligations: Spend on investment items and justify with invoices.
docs: ID and proof of residence in Andalucía
steps: Watch BOJA for the next call.
Apply online within the window (about one month).
Projects are scored and ranked.
Buy the investment items and justify with invoices.

name: Diputación de Málaga grant for autónomos in small towns
next_call: The 2026 call ran 28 April to 12 May. Watch for 2027.
paid: One payment of €6,000, justified by staying registered as autónomo and in the IAE.
summary: €6,000 for autónomos who live and work in a town under 20,000 people in Málaga province. Competitive: priority groups and newer autónomos score higher.
covers: Your autónomo quota for the year
obligations: Live and work in a town under 20,000 people, registered on its padrón for at least a year before the call.
2026 call: registered as autónomo (RETA) between 1 Jan 2022 and 1 Jan 2026, without interruption.
Keep the activity going for the required period and justify it afterwards.
docs: Proof of residence and business in the town
steps: Watch the Boletín Oficial de la Provincia de Málaga in spring.
Apply within the 10 working days of the call.
verification_note: Checked against the BOP Málaga and the Diputación’s official page.

name: FUNDAE training credit
body: FUNDAE (Fundación Estatal para la Formación en el Empleo)
amount_text: At least €420 a year for companies with 1 to 5 employees
paid: Recovered as a discount on Social Security payments after the training.
summary: Every company with staff has a yearly training budget, recovered as a Social Security discount. Unused credit carries over for up to 2 years.
covers: Staff training: barista skills, food handling, languages, customer service
obligations: Notify each course at least 2 days before it starts.
steps: Register the company in the FUNDAE application.
Choose training (barista, food handling, languages).
Notify the course start at least 2 days before.
Deduct the cost from Social Security payments afterwards.
verification_note: Not a grant to apply for: a credit every company with employees already has.

name: Tarifa plana (reduced autónomo quota)
amount_text: €80 a month instead of the full quota for 12 months
paid: Not a payment: a reduced monthly quota, with a second year if income stays under the minimum wage.
summary: New autónomos pay a reduced €80 a month for their first year instead of the full quota.
covers: Your first 12 months of Social Security
steps: Request it in the same process as your autónomo registration.

name: Pago único (capitalising unemployment benefit)
amount_text: Your remaining unemployment benefit as one payment
paid: Paid as one sum to start the business.
summary: If you receive unemployment benefit, you can take what’s left as one payment to start your business.
covers: Start-up investment or your first months of Social Security
steps: Apply to SEPE before registering as autónomo.
Once approved, register and start trading.
hidden_reason: Not yet checked against SEPE’s official page.
